title: Physics of the flying fish: glide data and Thompson's flight envelope
headline: SIM v3 (pre-registered): v2 failed on DRAG, not power: with the unsourced water drag removed the physiology chain's own power launches the real fish into the observed taxi-glide sequence (lift-off 16.5 m/s, six 36 m glides), and sustained aerobic flight still does not occur (0.009 W vs 1.44 W). LEAN agrees with kernel-accepted certificates (C14): sustained aerobic flight eliminated for the real fish and the flier, aerobic ceiling 0.0357 W vs 0.94-1.35 W, 26-38x short; burst flight and gliding not bounded. No fetched source gives a fish body or lobe drag coefficient, so the drag arm is untestable until one exists. v1 and v2 records stand. Flier: a 66 s anaerobic burst to 179 m; needs an air-breathing surface. Earlier: fish inside Thompson's envelope (v_min 9.85 vs quoted 10-20 m/s); no accessible source gives mass, fin area and airspeed for the same fish; R2-R8 proved; 11 unsigned nanopub drafts; birds excluded throughout.
